blocks.tamil_translation: accept my intercession!' The Qur'an will say, “I kept him away from sleeping at night. (He used to recite me in Nafl Salah at night.) In his matter accept my intercession!' In this way both of them will intercede for him,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَرْفَعُ بِهذَا الْكِتَابِ أَقْوَاماً وَيَضَعُ بِهِ آخَرِينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل من يقوم بالقران ...رقم:١٨٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Because of this Qur'an Allah raises the ranks of many and lowers the ranks of many. To those who act according to it, Allah gives honour in this world and in the Hereafter, and those who do not act according to it, Allah disgraces”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ (لأَبِي ذَرٍّ: ( عَلَيْكَ بِتِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ وَذِكْرِ اللهِ فَإِنَّهُ ذِكْرٌ لَّكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَنُورٌ لَّكَ فِي اْلاَرْضِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو جزء من الحديث) رواه البيهقي في شعب الايمان ٢٤٢/٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said to me: “O Abu Dharr, keep up the recitation of the Qur'an and the Dhikr of Allah diligently! Through this deed you will be remembered in the heaven. And it is a light of Hidayah (guidance) for you on earth”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا حَسَدَ إِلَّا فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ
